::: {#def-null-deviance}

#### Null deviance

The **null deviance** is the [deviance](#def-deviance) of the model with an intercept and no other predictors:

$$
\nulldeviance = -2 n \cb{\bar\outvar \ln \bar\outvar + \paren{1 - \bar\outvar} \ln\paren{1 - \bar\outvar}},
$$ {#eq-null-deviance}

where $\bar\outvar$ is the fraction of labels equal to $1$.

:::
